A hand-written helper reserves its name against generated regions, even
when a stale main.gen.go still declares the colliding generated form.

-- shared/shared.go --
package shared

import "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli"

type Store struct{}

type Report struct{}

//fabrik:provider name=db
func NewStore() (*Store, error) { return &Store{}, nil }

//fabrik:provider
//fabrik:inject s name=db
func NewReport(s *Store) (*Report, error) { return &Report{}, nil }

// Summarize the report.
//
//fabrik:cli:command
func Summarize(ctx cli.Context, r *Report) error {
	return nil
}

// Publish the report.
//
//fabrik:cli:command
func Publish(ctx cli.Context, r *Report) error {
	return nil
}
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli"

	"app/shared"
)

func run() int {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	sigc := make(chan os.Signal, 2)
	signal.Notify(sigc, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer signal.Stop(sigc)
	go func() {
		<-sigc
		cancel()
		<-sigc
		os.Exit(1)
	}()

	root := &cli.Command{
		Name: "app",
		Subcommands: []*cli.Command{
			{
				Name: "summarize",
				Help: "Summarize the report",
				Run: func(ctx cli.Context) (err error) {
					sharedReport, err := buildReport()
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					return shared.Summarize(ctx, sharedReport)
				},
			},
			{
				Name: "publish",
				Help: "Publish the report",
				Run: func(ctx cli.Context) (err error) {
					sharedReport, err := buildReport()
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					return shared.Publish(ctx, sharedReport)
				},
			},
		},
	}
	return root.Exec(os.Args[1:], cli.WithSignalContext(ctx))
}

func buildReport() (*shared.Report, error) {
	sharedStoreDb, err := shared.NewStore()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sharedReport, err := shared.NewReport(sharedStoreDb)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return sharedReport, nil
}
